clips.title: The story
paras: Deep within Razorfen Kraul, the Blind Hunter roosts in the sunless depths. This elusive albino bat prowls the quilboar redoubt, far from common bats near the cavern entrances.

Razorfen Kraul winds through briars and dark caverns below ground. Common bats roost nearer the surface, where faint light reaches in from outside. The Blind Hunter keeps to the furthest, darkest alcoves of the tangle. Its pale hide and milky gaze may come from generations spent apart from natural sunlight.

The Blind Hunter is thought to have lost most or all of its ordinary sight. Scholars and scouts believe it tracks prey through the gloom with keen hearing and echolocation. It rarely appears, hunting only now and then among the dense thickets. For cavern explorers, seeing this phantom beast is a rare encounter.
